skills.name: box-legal-workflows-contract
skills.description: Automate contract review and monitoring with Box MCP — find new or expiring contracts, compare them against firm templates to flag material variances, write structured contract metadata back to Box for searchability, and produce variance reports with citations. Use this skill when the user mentions contract review or monitoring, NDA or MSA review, contract expiration or renewals, contract metadata, or variance analysis, even if they don't name a specific Box tool.
skills.description_zh: 通过 Box MCP 自动化合同评审与监测，查找新合同或临近到期合同，对照律所模板标记重大差异，写回结构化合同元数据并生成有引用的差异报告，适用于 NDA/MSA、到期续约与偏差分析。

skills.name: box-legal-workflows-intake
skills.description: Automate legal client intake and onboarding with Box MCP — review intake documents for completeness against firm requirements, summarize risk for attorney review, route incomplete or high-risk submissions to the right attorney, extract client and matter metadata to Box, and generate engagement letters from Box DocGen templates. Use this skill when the user mentions client intake, client onboarding, new client review, intake documents, or engagement letters.
skills.description_zh: 通过 Box MCP 自动化法律客户受理和入职，按律所要求核对资料完整性、总结风险供律师审核，将不完整或高风险申请路由至适当律师，提取客户事项元数据并用 Box DocGen 模板生成委托函。

skills.name: box-legal-workflows-ma
skills.description: Build and manage M&A virtual data rooms with Box MCP — create secure due-diligence folder structures, scope role-based access for internal teams and external parties, validate permissions before sharing, and answer cross-document due-diligence questions with Box AI. Use this skill when the user mentions M&A, deal rooms, data rooms, VDRs, due diligence, or mergers and acquisitions.
skills.description_zh: 通过 Box MCP 建设和管理并购虚拟资料室，创建安全尽调目录、划定内部外部角色权限、分享前验证访问控制，并用 Box AI 回答跨文档尽调问题。

skills.name: box-legal-workflows
skills.description: Shared building blocks for Box-based legal workflows — Box collaboration role definitions, Box AI usage boundaries (what AI must not decide), and reusable human-in-the-loop confirmation phrasings. Referenced by box-legal-workflows-ma, box-legal-workflows-intake, and box-legal-workflows-contract skills.
skills.description_zh: 提供 Box 法律流程共用的基础规则，包括协作角色定义、AI不得自行决策的边界及可复用的人工确认措辞，供并购、客户受理和合同技能引用。

skills.name: box
skills.description: Foundation skill for working with Box. Use this whenever the user mentions Box — authentication and MCP/CLI setup, choosing between MCP/CLI/REST, rate-limit and pacing guidance, troubleshooting Box errors (401/403/404/409/429), or working with Box MCP tools (files, search, collaboration, AI, hubs, doc gen). Start here for any Box task even if the user doesn't name a specific tool, then route to the right reference.
skills.description_zh: 处理 Box 工作的基础接入与使用，涵盖认证、MCP/CLI设置、MCP/CLI/REST选择、限流节奏、401/403/404/409/429排错，以及文件、搜索、协作、AI、Hub和文档生成，并路由至对应参考资料。
